bio: Japan’s wealth of foodstuffs and culture support a creative approach to cuisine. The chef criss-cross Japan to connect farms with dinner tables. Vegan cooking is embraced here, seen as a lifestyle of the future. The principle of connecting to the good earth shines in desserts crafted with respect for nature and the herbs of Japan. ‘Flower tart’, for example, honours the culture of the rural hills. The possibilities of provincial villages presented in Ginza....
